New: Kittens Aristocats Loungefly x PBTI LE 1,000 (4 Sep 2021), Ratatouille LE 1,000 (25 May 2021), Ratatouille DPBStore lanyard 4pc set (held), Ratatouille blind box (5 designs held pending full-list decision). Star Wars Chibi pin records created but held. Peter Pan Signs Pixie Hollow/Crocodile Creek sign names resolved from DPB. No holds released.
